labels.name: kind/more-info-needed
labels.rationale: The report is missing required bug report sections: version, config, system info, and expected result.

body:
To help reproduce your issue, could you provide the following missing details?

- Prometheus version
- Prometheus configuration file
- System information (OS, Kubernetes version, etc.)
- What you expected to see

This information will help maintainers understand and address your problem more effectively. Thank you!
